name: C11_PI_CUT_VERTEX_COMPOSITION_GATE_V1

definition: C is a connected authoritative C11 PI residual component after only frozen deterministic propagation/normalization.
C is NOT_TW3_LIST_READY, with tw(C)>3 certified when needed by a frozen forbidden-minor model.
C is not exactly a six-vertex literal octahedron eligible for LITERAL_OCTAHEDRON_EXACT_LIST_TERMINAL.
domain.rationale: Residuals already solved by the base terminal library are outside this gate; the gate asks only whether remaining unresolved interaction factorizes across one cut vertex.

base_terminal_stack.L3_READY: Global missing color followed by the frozen P7-free List-3 terminal.
base_terminal_stack.TW3_LIST_READY: Verified width-3 decomposition followed by frozen arbitrary-list TW3 DP.
base_terminal_stack.LITERAL_OCTAHEDRON_EXACT_LIST_READY: The entire connected component is exactly a literal K_{2,2,2} on six vertices and is solved by <=4^6 exact assignments.

cut_vertex_discovery.Cut_C: Complete set of vertices r such that C-r has more connected components than C.
cut_vertex_discovery.algorithm: Enumerate every r in V(C), delete r, compute connected components, and retain exactly the articulation vertices.

good_cut_definition.formula: GOOD_CUT(C,r) := r in Cut(C) AND for every kappa in L(r), after fixing r=kappa and frozen propagation, every surviving connected component D is closed by the base terminal stack.
good_cut_definition.exact_factorization: For a fixed kappa, the branch is feasible iff every component of C-r with the kappa boundary restriction is feasible; frozen propagation may only simplify those independent component instances further.
good_cut_definition.empty_list_note: A domain residual has nonempty exact lists. If fixing kappa creates an empty list, that kappa branch is simply CONTRADICTION and therefore closed.

per_cut_branch_audit.for_each_r: Enumerate every kappa in the exact current L(r); no extension-oracle choice.
for_each_kappa: Preserve exact contradiction if one occurs.
Otherwise construct every surviving connected component D.
Classify D in strict order: L3_READY, TW3_LIST_READY, LITERAL_OCTAHEDRON_EXACT_LIST_READY, otherwise ESCAPE.
per_cut_branch_audit.branch_closed_iff: Every surviving D is in the base terminal stack.

S1_CUT_VERTEX_COMPOSITION_UNIVERSAL.label: S1_CUT_VERTEX_COMPOSITION_UNIVERSAL
pass_requires: A theorem/proof-carrying universal argument; finite corpus success is insufficient.
A polynomial graph-only rule finding at least one good articulation r(C) for each C.
For every kappa in L(r(C)), every resulting component is closed by the frozen base terminal stack.
Exact branch aggregation and reconstruction/UNSAT logic using cut-vertex factorization.
Polynomial accounting for articulation discovery, at most four colors of r, propagation, component decomposition, and all downstream terminal calls.
S1_CUT_VERTEX_COMPOSITION_UNIVERSAL.consequence_ceiling: The currently unresolved authoritative residual family is polynomially resolved by one-vertex separator composition over already-frozen component terminals.

LOCAL_CUT_ESCAPE.label: LOCAL_CUT_ESCAPE
LOCAL_CUT_ESCAPE.formula: exists C, exists r in Cut(C), exists kappa in L(r), exists surviving D outside the base terminal stack.
LOCAL_CUT_ESCAPE.interpretation: This proves only that one specific articulation r is not a good universal separator. It MUST NOT falsify S1 because another articulation r* in the same C may still be good.

S2_CUT_VERTEX_COMPOSITION_ESCAPE.label: S2_CUT_VERTEX_COMPOSITION_ESCAPE
S2_CUT_VERTEX_COMPOSITION_ESCAPE.strong_formula: exists authoritative C in domain such that [Cut(C)=empty] OR [for every r in Cut(C), exists kappa_r in L(r) and a certified surviving component D_{r,kappa_r} outside the base terminal stack].
interpretation: If Cut(C)=empty and |V(C)|>=3, the authoritative residual is genuinely cut-vertex-free / 2-connected.
Otherwise every articulation candidate is defeated by at least one color branch.
certificate_if_no_cut: complete authoritative C and exact lists
graph-only exhaustive Cut(C) enumeration receipt showing Cut(C)=empty
C remains outside the base terminal stack
certificate_if_all_cuts_defeated: complete authoritative C and exact lists
for every r in Cut(C), one exact defeating kappa_r
for every r, exact frozen propagation transcript
for every r, exact surviving connected D_{r,kappa_r}
tw(D)>3 certified by an explicit frozen forbidden-minor model
D is not exactly a six-vertex literal octahedron terminal
independent replay of cut-set completeness and every defeating branch
S2_CUT_VERTEX_COMPOSITION_ESCAPE.consequence_ceiling: There exists an authoritative residual whose unresolved interaction cannot be explained by a single articulation separator feeding the current component terminal library.

S3_GATE_UNRESOLVED.label: S3_GATE_UNRESOLVED
S3_GATE_UNRESOLVED.condition: Neither theorem-level S1 nor complete strong-S2 certificate is established.

quantifier_binding.GOOD_cut_formula: exists r in Cut(C) for all kappa in L(r): Closed(C,r,kappa).
quantifier_binding.exact_negation_for_one_C: Cut(C)=empty OR for all r in Cut(C) exists kappa_r in L(r): not Closed(C,r,kappa_r).
quantifier_binding.rule: A single LOCAL_CUT_ESCAPE cannot falsify S1.

required: tw(D)>3 with explicit frozen forbidden-minor model from {K5,OCTAHEDRON,WAGNER_V8,PENTAGONAL_PRISM}
D is not exactly a six-vertex literal octahedron
all fixed-boundary restrictions encoded in exact lists

mandatory_quantifier_controls.name: TWO_CUT_MIXED_CONTROL
mandatory_quantifier_controls.structure: Synthetic residual with two articulation candidates r1,r2.
required_behavior: r1 has at least one escaping color branch.
r2 closes for every color branch.

mandatory_quantifier_controls.name: NO_CUT_CONTROL
mandatory_quantifier_controls.structure: Synthetic connected graph with at least three vertices and no articulation vertex, outside the mocked base terminal labels.

anti_cheat: Do not stop after the first bad articulation when attempting S2.
Do not choose r or kappa using extension knowledge.
Do not call a component escaped merely because a heuristic TW3 decomposition search fails; require an explicit forbidden-minor certificate.
Do not call an exact six-vertex literal octahedron an escape; it is now an authorized terminal.
Do not open tw4, backdoor size 2, repair, separator size 2, or new state language.
next_action: Separate authorization required. Audit only one-vertex separator composition over the frozen base terminal stack and stop at S1/strong-S2/S3.
